result.note: S2's broadened search method generalizes cleanly: all 4 production goals have real provenance (3 via Experience records, 1 -- character_narrative_intelligence -- via the SSI incorporation chain S2 found). No gap forced where none exists.

cause.root_cause_summary: A fix proven for one case isn't proven general until it's re-applied systematically to every comparable case -- here, the 3 other production goals already had Experience-shaped provenance, so the generalized check mainly re-confirmed S2's fix held rather than finding new problems.

lesson: Generalizing a fix means re-testing it against every case it should apply to, including the ones that were already passing -- this is what distinguishes 'the method works for this one case' from 'the method is the right general approach.'
